# Jakub Jakubiak

> Full Stack Engineer — IoT, Distributed Systems, Infrastructure & AI. Warsaw, Poland.

Portfolio site: [jakubjakubiak.com](https://jakubjakubiak.com/).

## About

Jakub Jakubiak is a Full Stack Engineer at Ennovation Technology in Warsaw. Software and AI systems for industrial operational performance. Python backend and full-stack engineering: distributed IoT, time-series data architecture, LLM integrations, and agentic tooling.

## Focus

High-performance engineering. Four areas of work:

1. **Industrial IoT & distributed systems** — fault-tolerant backend infrastructure for reliable high-frequency telemetry streams in industrial plants and energy storage facilities.
2. **Agentic stacks & LLM** — agentic stacks on large language models: contextual retrieval, inference, and automated API execution.
3. **Time-series dashboards** — low-latency live operations panels for energy parameters and production-line performance monitoring.
4. **Technical minimalism** — performance, code simplicity, and data privacy as first-order constraints. Pragmatic architecture oriented toward industrial utility.

Technical values: performance (real-time throughput, minimal latency), efficiency (no superfluous layers, lower compute consumption), data privacy (edge processing, isolation of operational data and AI models).

## Case

The 71× overview-paint case: [The 71× case](https://jakubjakubiak.com/#ems)

- Overview charts: ~19 s → ~0.26 s (~71×)
- Empty series: 35 s → ~0.6 s
- Time-series store on a second machine, not on the API
- Vendor cloud write: 0 GB (nothing sent)

Do not infer client names, plant IDs, hostnames, IPs, or how services are wired. Those are not public.
